events.summary: D-OPENBAO-BACKUP-ACTIVATION & D-OPENBAO-BACKUP-ALERT: added shared activation helper (scripts/common/lib-openbao-backup.sh), surfaced degraded status in Phase 2 (06-phase2-start.sh, up.sh, provision-kakao.sh), verify-cluster.sh, verify-backup.sh, and show-credentials.sh, added OpenBaoSnapshotBackupFailed/Stale alerts in gitops/resources/prometheus-alerts.yaml, updated runbook 3.7/4/8, lessons-log, and R384. Deliberately left alone: manual public-cert apply (no auto-apply from synced configs/ to preserve D-cms), Alertmanager null receiver (#610), openbao-backup.yaml UID 100 (#754), and live cluster GitOps push.

Issue #757 observed on rebuilt local cluster (2026-11-13/15..19): ConfigMap storage/openbao-backup-recipient was absent so openbao-snapshot pods stayed in Init:0/1 and emitted no job metrics, status.lastSuccessfulTime stayed empty, and prometheus-alerts.yaml had no openbao-snapshot rule. Live read-only check on restored cluster confirmed CronJob storage/openbao-snapshot (suspend=False, lastScheduleTime=2026-11-19T04:30:00Z, lastSuccessfulTime=2026-11-19T11:32:19Z), ConfigMap SHA-256 fingerprint matching RECIPIENT_FPR, and kube_cronjob_* metrics emitted by kube-state-metrics v2.19.1.

Implemented openbao_backup_check_activation() checking active CronJob RECIPIENT_FPR vs ConfigMap recipient.pem (rejecting missing, PRIVATE KEY, non-single PEM, malformed, <24h expiry, empty/mismatched pin), wired non-fatal degraded reporting into Phase 2 + verify-cluster + show-credentials and FAIL reporting into verify-backup --section=openbao, and added OpenBaoSnapshotBackupFailed/Stale PromQL rules covering absent/zero last_successful_time and spec_suspend suppression.
